title: Re-roll 3, bolder: foreign forms at full commitment
question: Bolder hand. It leads with the collider event display; two challengers beat it on both axes. Pick one, or re-roll.

options.label: Event display: every project a collision
options.thesis: Each project shown as one frozen event: the product moment at the centre, tracks curving out through the layers it touched (DB, API, UI, LLM), labelled plainly.
options.viewport: A rotating event display fills the right two-thirds, with tracks labelled Callbell CRM, AI assistant and so on. Left: QWERTIC, AI engineer, full stack, and Book a call. Selecting a track isolates it and opens its facts.
options.risk: A dark screen with glowing lines drifts toward AI-hype, and it's a metaphor again, so labels must do all the explaining.

raised.raise: One control reshapes the page: switching Hiring or Project changes which tracks light up.
Every track carries a plain label and a date, never colour alone.

options.label: Risograph: printed in two inks
options.thesis: The whole site printed in fluoro pink and federal blue on white paper, slightly out of register, with big plain type saying exactly what he does.
options.viewport: QWERTIC huge in blue with a pink offset layer, "AI engineer, full stack" in black, and the current AI work as a printed block. Hovering nudges the inks out of register.
options.case: Beats the event display on both counts: plain type makes it instantly clear, and it has real personality without a metaphor.
options.risk: Riso is a popular indie look; it needs a sharp grid and real restraint to read as product-grade.

options.label: Plane portrait: Ikko Tanaka
options.thesis: A portrait of Qwertic built from a handful of flat coloured planes on a strict grid, with quiet, plain captions carrying the facts.
options.viewport: A monumental figure (a face, or the Q, made of five planes) owns the left half. Right: QWERTIC, AI engineer, full stack, three plain lines and Book a call. Planes recompose per section.
options.case: Beats the event display on both counts: calm, clear captions, and personal because it is literally a portrait.
options.risk: Close to a poster tribute; the planes have to relate to the work, not just decorate the page.

options.label: Green field, floating capsules
options.lineage: contemporary product marketing with pill UI
options.thesis: One saturated green owns the viewport, and the interface floats on it as white capsules.
options.viewport: A green field, a flush-left oversized headline, and a floating capsule bar with Book a call.
options.case: Holds on clarity and product-grade polish; loses on personality, since it looks like a SaaS launch page.
options.risk: Reads as a startup landing page, not a person.

options.label: Brine calendar
options.case: Loses on both counts: culinary again, and it needs decoding.
options.kept: Plain labels with dates on every item.

options.label: Drawcord cape
options.case: Loses on both counts: fashion abstraction.
options.kept: One control that transforms the page.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The clean designer-engineer portfolio, done with full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Name, one line, a short list of work and writing, contact.
canonCard.risk: Clean and familiar by design; the personality has to come from the details.
